career_ladder.note: Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) is the entry-level running staff position in Indian Railways operating electric and diesel locomotives. Promotion through the loco running cadre is determined by operational running experience, safety records, locomotive conversion courses, and trade tests. Running staff transition from assisting goods trains to piloting high-speed Express and Vande Bharat trains, with opportunities to advance to supervisory management as Chief Loco Inspector.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to Assistant Loco Pilot (CEN 01/2024) is conducted in five sequential stages: First Stage CBT (CBT-1 screening); Second Stage CBT (CBT-2 consisting of Part A for merit and Part B for qualifying trade test); Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT / Psycho test); Document Verification (DV); and Medical Examination under strict A-1 medical category standards.

stages.source_label: RRB CEN 01/2024 — Examination Scheme for First Stage CBT

papers.paper_name: General Science (Physics, Chemistry & Life Sciences of 10th standard, 20 questions)
General Awareness on Current Affairs (Science, Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, 10 questions)

stages.source_label: RRB CEN 01/2024 — Examination Scheme for Second Stage CBT

papers.paper_name: Part A: Mathematics, Reasoning, Basic Science and Engineering (drawing, units, mechanics, electricity, heat), General Awareness (100 questions)
papers.qualifying_threshold: UR/EWS: 40%, OBC: 30%, SC: 30%, ST: 25% (70% weightage in final merit)

papers.paper_name: Part B: Relevant Technical Trade Syllabus prescribed by DGET / NCVT (75 questions)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying mark: 35% for all candidates (no relaxation)

stages.stage_name: Stage 3: Computer-Based Aptitude Test (CBAT / Psycho Test)
stages.source_label: RDSO Guidelines for Computer-Based Aptitude Testing for ALP

papers.paper_name: 5 Battery Test (Memory, Direction, Depth Perception, Concentration, Perceptual Speed)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum T-Score of 42 in each of the 5 test batteries (30% weightage in final merit)

stages.source_label: Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM) — Medical Standard A-1

papers.paper_name: A-1 Medical Examination: Distant vision 6/6, 6/6 without glasses (no fogging test), near vision Sn 0.6, 0.6 without glasses, must pass tests for colour vision, binocular vision, field of vision, and night vision

financial_package.note: Assistant Loco Pilot is placed in Pay Level 2 (₹19,900 – ₹63,200) under the 7th CPC. In addition to basic pay and DA, ALPs earn substantial Running Allowance (Kilometerage Allowance — KMA) based on the distance run during duty, significantly raising their in-hand earnings compared to stationary Level 2 employees.
financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Railway Services (Revised Pay) Rules, Ministry of Railways
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 2 basic pay of ₹19,900 with 58% DA (₹11,542), HRA (10% to 30%), Transport Allowance (₹900 to ₹1,350 + DA on TA), plus Running Allowance (KMA approx ₹4.30 to ₹5.50 per km, generating an estimated ₹12,000 to ₹25,000/month), Night Duty Allowance (NDA), and National Holiday Allowance (NHA).
official_perks: Running Allowance (Kilometerage Allowance / KMA) for distance travelled on duty
Night Duty Allowance (NDA) and National Holiday Allowance (NHA)
Free Railway Pass and Privilege Ticket Orders (PTO) for family rail travel across India
Comprehensive medical treatment in Railway Hospitals and health units for employee and dependents
Railway residential colony quarters allocation or HRA
Rest room and running room facilities equipped with air-conditioned cubicles and subsidized meals
